HomePage.description: I provide specialized cybersecurity consulting for small to mid-sized businesses. From vulnerability assessments to network hardening, I ensure your assets stay secure.
HomePage.servicesDescription: Modern security requires a multi-layered approach. Here is how I can help you mitigate risk.
HomePage.serviceDescription1: Simulated cyberattacks against your computer system to check for exploitable vulnerabilities.
HomePage.serviceDescription2: Securing your network infrastructure by reducing the surface of vulnerability through configuration audits.
HomePage.serviceDescription3: Ensuring your business meets industry standards (SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) regarding data privacy.
HomePage.aboutDescription: I am a security professional with a background in system administration and offensive security.
